de: According to the exit poll of the ARD TV channel, in the elections to the Chamber of Deputies of Berlin, the Left party leads with 24.5% of the vote.

de: The Iraqi portal Shafaq news, citing a source in the security agencies, reported that Iran has notified Iraq about the likelihood of stopping receiving arriving flights from all countries of the world from Tuesday.

de: Ella Pamfilova, the chairman of Russia’s Central Election Commission, said that all Muscovites who managed to enter polling stations before their closure will be able to vote. The committees will continue to work until the last voter.
